children: TTM Technologies priced $500 million of 6.750% senior notes due 2034 to help fund the proposed acquisition of Epiq Solutions.
Priced $500 million aggregate principal of 6.750% senior unsecured notes due 2034 in a private Rule 144A/Reg S offering.
Sale expected to close September 24, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
Notes will be guaranteed by subsidiaries that guarantee TTM’s senior secured credit facilities, subject to exceptions.
Proceeds, plus expected $300M term loan A and $800M term loan B borrowings, intended to fund the proposed Epiq Solutions acquisition and related fees.
If the Epiq acquisition is not consummated by the Outside Date, TTM must redeem the Notes at 100% principal plus accrued interest.
